pi_input_events.summary: Set up Conda, train the RL agents, and prepare the HTML report for GitHub Pages.

model_provenance: Local Codex turn-context records identify the parent model and reasoning effort. Local tool-call records give the launch times and show that all 16 full-context delegates inherited this configuration without overrides.

pi_input: ny asked to review the repository, set up Conda and RL training, and prepare the interactive report for GitHub Pages.
pi_feedback: “Try increasing the network size and also experiment on the other 3 instances.”
agent_work: Set up the shhcsrp conda environment, compared the fixed policies with RL, and built the offline report and GitHub Pages workflow. The RL action represented a rank in the current eligible list.
computation: Instance A contained 60 appointments. GPU training used four Optuna trials and 16,384 final steps per algorithm. The report averaged 12 held-out seeds.
finding: DQN led RL validation. On the held-out seeds it averaged 54.50 visits and 438.08 reward. Random averaged 56.92 visits and 484.41 reward. Earliest deadline and ant colony completed all 60 visits on every seed.

delegation.work: Built the interactive report for policies, routes, schedules, appointments, and event traces.
Prepared and checked the static Pages publishing workflow.

Added the earliest-deadline baseline and optional paired per-appointment service disturbances. Streamlined dispatch validation, fixed Windows UTF-8 handling in a report test, and verified all eight simulator tests.

availability: The results above were recorded in the conversation. Per-seed traces, training losses, and checkpoints from this run are unavailable in the current workspace.
